{{Top|leg}}
Challah oats were an edible plant found on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Princess Kneesa picked a handful of them for her [[Bordok/Legends|Bordok]], Baga, as they were his favorite snack. However, the monster known as the Raich appeared and started them before Baga could eat the Challah oats.<ref name="2-05">{{Ewoks|The Raich}}</ref>
